lines.en: I plod across the stone, step by step.
Bright scales hang all over me.
A fall can't hurt me.
The saddle shifts on my back.
My tail sweeps through the grass.
I round the wooden stake at the gate.
My pads slap the ground.
This height doesn't scare me.

lines.zh: 胖身子一沉，坡就滑下去了。
lines.en: My bulk settles and I slide down the slope.
I'm still carrying cargo.
The children run alongside me.
I turn slowly.
I lie down to rest.
The bag on my back is bulging.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一甩，背上叮当作响。
lines.en: My tail swings and my pack rattles.
The sun makes my scales shine.
I don't need anyone to feed me.
I glance up once.
The ground here is flat.
I roll over once.
I'm covered in dirt.
The wind rattles my scales.
I shift my haunches.

lines.zh: 晒太阳的胖龙，懒得睁眼。
lines.en: A sunbathing chubby dragon cannot be bothered to open its eyes.
Just lie here a while.
I tuck my legs under me.

lines.zh: 爬上来，我这背驮得动你。
lines.en: Climb on. My back can carry you.
The saddle on my back is empty.

lines.zh: 鞍就在背上，你还等什么？
lines.en: The saddle is right there; what are you waiting for?
Don't pull my scales.
Not just anyone rides me.
Keep your hands off my saddle.
I don't like being slapped.
You smell like a stranger.
This frame of mine is heavy.
Step back while I get up.

lines.zh: 我背上的包，能装一堆东西。
lines.en: The pack on my back carries plenty.
Don't touch my mouth.
You stand under my belly, so small.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻你的袖子。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff your sleeve.
You're a bit tense, aren't you.
My back is wide enough. Climb on.
You touched my scales.
I shifted one step.

lines.zh: 背包里的东西替我挡了一下。
lines.en: My pack took that hit for me.
That landed on my scales.
You're fairly strong.
I can't even swing my tail.
My back hurts a little.
Want to try again?
I'm standing, not falling.

lines.zh: 摔都摔不疼我，这点算什么。
lines.en: Falls do not hurt me; what is this?

lines.zh: 闪光的东西，我背上都装得下。
lines.en: Anything that glitters fits in my packs.

lines.zh: 我要的是甜的，不是铁片。
lines.en: I want something sweet, not scrap iron.

lines.zh: 你举得再高我也够得到。
lines.en: Hold it as high as you like. I can reach.
Put it down. I'll take it myself.
I'm not picky.
Is that the smell of meat?
Step back and I'll come over.
Is this enough for me?
Do not pull your hand back; I am not done sniffing.
My stomach growled.
You bumped into me.
I don't even wobble.
My hide is thick.
That hurt you, didn't it.

lines.zh: 胖龙转身，得挪好几次脚。
lines.en: A chubby dragon turns in several shuffles.
The pack on my back is fatter than I am.
You went around my legs.
My tail touched you.
My belly shoves and you stagger two steps.

lines.zh: 背上驮着东西，撞不动我。
lines.en: Loaded with cargo, and you can't move me.
No one keeps my kind.
My back is still loaded.
Don't ask me about that.
I only want to keep walking.
There's another one beyond the hill.
She's a little lighter than I am.
Step back a bit.
We're only greeting each other.
This is none of your business.
I'm going.

lines.zh: 背上驮得太多，我叼着走。
lines.en: My back is loaded full, so I carry it in my mouth.
This weight on my back is still carried.
I toss it into my back bag.
You dropped it?
I'm not giving it back.
Shiny. Just my taste.
I stepped on it and it flattened.
It's stuck in a rock crack.

lines.zh: 鼻尖一拱，东西滚进背包。
lines.en: One nudge of my snout rolls it into my pack.
The bag still has room.
Someone's blocking the way ahead.
I want to pass.
Don't stand in my path.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，走过去就够了。
lines.en: I need not run; walking there is enough.
What you're holding is glinting.
I smell a stranger.
I'll watch that cargo first.
Just step back.
I don't want to hit you.
But I won't go around.
The cargo on my back can't fall.
I drop my head low.
I walk that road every day.
Just step aside.
I'm walking toward you.
My steps are heavy.
The ground carries my footsteps.
The ground is shaking.
My load is rocking badly.
I stretch my neck forward.
No way out by the wall; a chubby dragon plugs it.

lines.zh: 我这身厚皮，摔下去也不怕。
lines.en: With this hide, a fall means nothing.
A few steps between us.
Step aside or we collide.
My breathing is rough.
I can see just where you are.
My tail has gone stiff.
Almost there.
This one will be heavy.

lines.zh: 我把肚皮压低，滚过去撞。
lines.en: I lower my belly and roll into you.
You slid away from the impact.
I sweep with my tail.
I put my whole body into that.
I stepped on you.
You nearly lost your footing.
I swing my shoulder into you.
I crowded you into the ditch.
My thick scales turn it into a scratch.
My saddle is still on; do not stir trouble.
I lean my flank into you.

lines.zh: 我的前脚落地，震了一下。
lines.en: My forefoot lands with a thud.
I crowd you to the road's edge.
My round body slams and the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 坡上的碎石，被我踩得直滚。
lines.en: The scree on the slope scatters under my feet.
The scales on my back clink.
Someone peers out from the village.
I stop in the middle of the road.
Look at all this on me.
All of it is mine.
I slowly lie down.

lines.zh: 风把我背上的布吹起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts the cloth on my back.
My shadow lies on the ground.
Is there anything to eat around here?

lines.zh: 我落地的时候地都震了。
lines.en: The ground shook when I landed.
I roll down the hillside; clear the way.
The scales on me throw back the light.
I put my nose to the ground.
This road leads to the village.
I lift my heavy neck.
Fire heats my scales until they burn.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，我一点没事。
lines.en: Rolling down the slope, I'm fine.
The water's deep. I can only float.
The blast pushed me a few steps.

lines.zh: 一支箭弹开在我的鳞上。
lines.en: An arrow glanced off my scales.

lines.zh: 一道光打过来，我的鳞闪光。
lines.en: A flash hit me and my scales flashed.
The bag is empty, and I'm hungry too.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，脚下一软。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and my legs gave.
No ground to stand on here. I'm afraid.
